_comment: The project/epic/tick line every operator message is prefixed with.
Two readers compose it: internal/operator/context.go (local Telegram
Worker, which composes gate messages and reports for MANY projects into
ONE chat). A drift between them is invisible to both suites — each would
keep rendering a line a human can read — while the two halves of the same
conversation stopped agreeing on how a project is named. Hence the

cases.name: a second project is legible against the first
no epic — a tick asked outside a run
surrounding whitespace is not part of an identifier
nothing known — no prefix at all, never an empty frame

prefix_examples.name: the line goes above the message, separated by one newline
an unknown context leaves the message exactly as written
